audit_findings_measured: F-A · THE FICTION: the Z-70/Z-71 books and CR-0046 told '14 converts 45.3 SBD → feed STEEM Oct 7' and 'the Oct 7 convert maturity (~435 STEEM)' — both UNMEASURED. A 400-page sequence-space walk (headcorner seq 65028→46848, Oct-3T22:45 back to Sep-6T09:16, api.steem.fans/api.justyy/api.steemit.com cross-checked) measured the chain truth: 23 converts opened Oct-2T12:02..Oct-3T13:38 totaling 117.887 SBD, ZERO closures in window (no fill_convert_request ops), maturities by the open+3.5d chain law land 2026-10-06T00:02:12Z → 2026-10-07T01:38:21Z. The '~435 STEEM' story conflated the drip runway (real: 475.88 SP/wk powerdown) with convert maturity (7.348 SBD/day-scale). The wave is real, 4x smaller than told, and now dated to the minute.

F-B · THE BROKEN WIRE (revived): agents/convert-canon.cjs read the sensor book's `rows` while agents/earn-audit.cjs writes `per_account` — sensor memory composed EMPTY forever; sensor_rows was pinned 0 by EVERY canon run since birth (all committed books prove it). Fixed: `ea.per_account || ea.rows` — both shapes legal. Live re-run: sensor_rows=2 on the first compose after the fix.

F-C · THE PHANTOM DATE (computed, never guessed): the chain `convert` op carries NO conversion_date (measured live across 23 ops: body = {amount, owner, requestid} only). The sensor booked `conversion_date: undefined` — JSON-dropped — and the canon's matures_within_24h window was DEAD CODE since birth. Fixed at BOTH layers: earn-audit tallyOp computes matures_at = open + 3.5d from the op timestamp; convert-canon walk rows carry `ts` and the reducer applies the same law. The 3.5d figure is the STEEM chain law, not a guess.

F-D · THE SEQ-RACE LAUNDERING (pinned): the reducer's last-open-wins law let walked rows (high seq, undated) OVERWRITE the sensor's dated rows (seq 0) — the sensor's computed date was laundered away on every compose, silently. Fixed: a dated row's conversion_date survives the race; a higher-seq open updates seq+amount but never erases a best-known date. Caught live in the first full wire test — the fixture dated row survived only after the fix.

F-E · THE UNDATED BUCKET: a convert with no parseable maturity now lands in `undated` (honest measured blind spot, note carried) — never guessed, never NaN-bracketed into pending/matured. The book gains `undated` + `undated_window` fields.

F-F · THE WALK DEPTH LAW: the canon's 30-page walk (~13h of measured density) saw only the ladder's tail while its job is the FULL pending schedule (maturity horizon open+84h). MAX_PAGES 30→90 (measured: the full 23-row ladder sits inside 60 pages; 90 = need + headroom; ~21s walk cost, rides the existing tick cadence).

F-G · SAMPLER-DEFECT LESSON (self-incident, booked fail-loud): the audit's own first walk used a `seq >= minSeq` dedupe guard that, against nodes returning ASCENDING pages, skipped every row but the first — producing a false 'ZERO converts exist' reading that would have booked the rotation fiction as DOUBLE-dead. The estate's PRINT-actual-values law (Z-69) caught it: page logs showed kinds summing to 32 against 3200 walked rows. Re-walked correctly. Lesson: a dedupe guard must be proven against BOTH page orders, never assumed.

laws_pinned: THE MATURITY LAW: a chain `convert` op's maturity = open_ts + 3.5d — computed by the fleet, never read from the chain (the field does not exist), never guessed from context
THE BEST-DATE-SURVIVES LAW: in any sensor/walk merge, a dated row's date beats an undated row regardless of seq order — the last-open-wins law governs AMOUNT and OPEN, never the best-known schedule
THE UNDATED BUCKET LAW: no parseable maturity = the undated bucket with a carried note — never pending, never matured, never NaN
THE WIRE-SHAPE LAW: cross-desk book readers must accept the writer's ACTUAL shape (per_account) — a reader invented against an imagined shape is a broken wire that green books hide
